285:     fn split_column_value(&self, v: &Value, separator: &Regex) -> Vec<Value> {
286:         if let Ok(s) = v.coerce_str() {
287:             let split_result = self.collect_column_parts(separator, &s);
288:             if self.collapse_empty && split_result.is_empty() && self.column_names.is_empty() {
289:                 return vec![Value::record(Record::new(), self.column_head)];
290:             }
291:             vec![self.record_from_column_parts(&split_result)]
292:         } else {
293:             vec![self.column_value_error(v)]
294:         }
295:     }

297:     fn collect_column_parts<'a>(&self, separator: &'a Regex, s: &'a str) -> Vec<&'a str> {
298:         separator
299:             .split(s)
300:             .filter(|x| !(self.collapse_empty && x.is_empty()))
301:             .collect()
302:     }

304:     fn generated_column_names(&self, count: usize) -> Vec<String> {
305:         if self.column_names.is_empty() {

307:         } else {
308:             self.column_names.clone()

312:     fn record_from_column_parts(&self, split_result: &[&str]) -> Value {
313:         let names = self.generated_column_names(split_result.len());
314:         let mut record = Record::new();
315:         if self.column_names.is_empty() {
